details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2740-2749 (also 952-963) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Phase 8b verified nothing-to-implement close (`unblock_nothing_to_implement_close` with empty fixup) runs for any standalone issue without excluding `ai:check-triage` issues, and it runs before `unblock_triage_superseded_note`. A check-triage issue that Q129 reports as unverified can therefore be closed as completed without CI evidence.
  WHY: Passing the plan's listed tests on the planning ref does not prove the failing CI check is fixed. That contradicts the #9659/Q129 evidence-close flow (plan.yml:2684, scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1015-1042), and the close also fires when CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED_GATE_ENABLED is false. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed and dropped this item: it says Phase 8a's scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh already closes matching issues with no `ai:check-triage` exclusion (lines 216-240), so 8b does not introduce the behavior.
- agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md:2 (also changelog.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md bullet 2, line 5) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Neither fragment documents the third eligibility condition the last run added at scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 908-912: the newest trusted block must contain the `pass_note`. Only the function header comment (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:895-899) mentions it.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the folded agents.md would describe a looser rule than the code applies. The source rated this NIT. Three other reviewers raised the same gap as a task gap (see CONSENSUS TASK GAPS).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The documentation fragments must describe the verified-close eligibility rules as shipped, including the new requirement that the newest trusted "Planning blocked" comment contains the verify's pass-but-close-failed note (`pnti_note_failed_pass`).
  expected_change_site: agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md line 2; changelog.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md bullet 2
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both fragments list only the marker requirement and the second-newest-block floor. The hardened jq at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:905, 911/913 (`(($block_comments | last // {}) | .body // "") | contains($pass_note)`) adds the note requirement. Only the script header comment at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:895-899 documents it. As a result, the folded agents.md (via scripts/assemble_agents.py) and the next @stable changelog would describe a weaker rule than the code applies.
- requirement: Phase 8b calls for "fragments plus README env var rows". The README must document that PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED also gates the unblock judge's verified close.
  expected_change_site: README.md, the `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED` row at line 3125 (environment variables table)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk updates README.md. gemini says the flag is missing from the env var table. minimax and luna say the existing row at line 3125 covers only plan-side verify, although .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:206 now forwards the variable and scripts/unblock_judge.sh:947 parses it to gate verified mode. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, minimax/luna NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly declined this gap because README.md is outside the Phase 8b file list and the `files_touched` grant.
- requirement: Plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md line 332 says to allow the close without a finished fix-up "when a trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` or `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker exists ... This clears blocks that existed before 8a merged". Line 202 says "existing blocks close on the judge's next run without a fix-up."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified` and `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close` (verified mode)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The newest block must now contain the Phase 8a `pnti_note_failed_pass` text (lines 909, 912). A block written before 8a merged can never contain it, so no pre-8a block can qualify. Pre-8a blocks go through the judge's `reset` verdict instead. The reviewer recorded this as residual and does not recommend widening the rule.
- requirement: Phase 8b allows the close without a finished fix-up when a trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` or `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker exists.
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The function checks only for the exact `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` comment marker. It has no check for the `outcome=closed`-equivalent marker.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md:2 (also changelog.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md, bullet 2 (line 5)) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The last run added a third eligibility condition in scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 908-912: `(($block_comments | last // {}) | .body // "") | contains($pass_note)`. Neither fragment mentions it. Only scripts/unblock_judge.sh:895-899 does.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the fragment describes a looser rule than the code applies. The code keeps such blocks open (see `single_block_failed_verify` and `single_block_no_note` in tests/test_unblock_judge.py). Fix: add a `pnti_note_failed_pass` clause to both fragments.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md line 332 (allow close when a trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` or `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker exists; "This clears blocks that existed before 8a merged") and line 202 ("existing blocks close on the judge's next run without a fix-up").
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified` and `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close`, verified mode.
  Evidence of absence: The newest block must now contain `pnti_note_failed_pass` (lines 909, 912), so no pre-8a block can qualify. Pre-8a blocks go through the `reset` verdict instead. Recorded as residual, with no change recommended. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- Verified correct: the pass note matches `pnti_note_failed_pass` (scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:184; used at :186, :209, :218), plan.yml writes it at lines 2679-2681, the floor rule is correct, and `sort_by(.created_at)` agrees with `unblock_nothing_to_implement_blocked` (line 881).
- Dropped the pass-1 check-triage gate MAJOR (from openai_gpt-6-luna): Phase 8a (scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh lines 216-240) has no `ai:check-triage` exclusion, and 8b only finishes 8a's failed close (line 217).
- Dropped the pass-1 README task gap: README.md is outside the Phase 8b file list (line 202, Files section lines 480+) and the `files_touched` grant.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified`, `((($block_comments | last // {}) | .body // "") | contains($pass_note))`. `contains()` matches anywhere in the body, including the model-derived `Reason: ${BLOCKED_REASON}` (plan.yml:2677). Fix: match a whole line, e.g. `split("\n") | map(rtrimstr("\r")) | any(test("^Verify: [0-9]+ test\\(s\\) passed on the planning ref, but the issue could not be closed automatically; the block stays\\.$"))`. Estimated 2-3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2740-2749 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new verified nothing-to-implement close runs for any standalone issue. It does not exclude issues that need triage resolution or wait for triage processing to finish.
  WHY: Check-triage issues can pass planning-ref tests and still need triage-check evidence, so they may be closed before the triage-check handler can hold them.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Document the eligibility requirement that the newest trusted "Planning blocked" comment must contain the pass-but-close-failed note (pnti_note_failed_pass).
  Expected change site: agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md and changelog.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md.
  Evidence of absence: Both fragments document the marker requirement and the floor condition but omit the note requirement enforced in scripts/unblock_judge.sh. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Document PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED in README.md.
  Expected change site: README.md (environment variables table).
  Evidence of absence: No hunk updates the README env var table to include the flag, which the plan and orchestrator instructions require. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified, line 913. `contains($pass_note)` can false-positive on model-derived reason text. Fix: anchor the match, e.g. test("Verify: .*passed on the planning ref.*"). Estimated 2-3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The verified close does not exclude `ai:check-triage` issues and does not check the Q129 verdict. It runs after the Q129 gate (lines 2733-2738) but before unblock_triage_superseded_note (lines 2747-2751). plan.yml:2517-2540 runs verify without a check-triage exclusion, and plan.yml:2679-2680 writes the note for check-triage issues too.

This bypasses the Q129 evidence close (scripts/check_triage_resolution.py, `ai:check-triage-resolved:v1`) and contradicts unblock_triage_superseded_note (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1015-1042) and the changelog's consumer-repo line.

  Expected change site: agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md line 2; changelog.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md bullet 2.
  Evidence of absence: agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md:2 lists only the marker and floor rule. scripts/unblock_judge.sh:911 adds `contains($pass_note)`, which only the header comment at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:895-899 documents. The folded agents.md (scripts/assemble_agents.py) and the @stable changelog would describe a weaker rule. | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  Expected change site: README.md line 3125 (the PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED row).
